snippet.title: 4 Friends. 1 Wallet. 999,999,999 in Debt. | Gamble Hunters - Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
You owe Captain Gold 999,999,999. He wants it back.

Gamble Hunters is a first-person casino action roguelite for 1-4 players.
Hunt monsters for 60 seconds, fill the shared wallet, then race your friends to the casino and turn it into your own Gold. First come, first served.

🤝 1-4 player online co-op
🔫 Hunt together, earn together
🎰 Slots, roulette, baccarat and more
💰 Shared Rupees, personal Gold, shared debt
⚙️ Weapon upgrades, skill tree and cosmic artifacts
💀 Bosses that get bigger every chapter

Pay off the debt before the deadline, or go bankrupt.

👉 Wishlist on Steam: https://store.steampowered.com/app/5117630/Gamble_Hunters

All bets use in-game virtual currency only. No real-money gambling, no additional purchases.

#GambleHunters #CoopGame #Indiegame #gamble #gambler #gambleaware
